name: 77053 · Houston, TX
findings: ZIP 77053 (Houston) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77053 (Houston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 77053 (Houston) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).
